subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence and select the option that rectifies the spelling error.

The idea is to encourage tourism and allow visitors to enjoy the spectacular Rockies, but to ensure that it is done in hermony with the environment.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hermony"** is incorrectly spelt and should be **"Harmony"**. (सामंजस्य)

 
 
• **Example: **The choir sang in perfect **harmony.**
 
 
 
• **"Harmony"** refers to a state of peaceful agreement and cooperation. (सामंजस्य)
 
 
• **Example: **We must work in** harmony **with nature to preserve the environment.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Harmony**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Enssure** (सुनिश्चित): This is an incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is **"Ensure".**

 
 
• **Example:** Please **ensure** that all the doors are locked before you leave.
 
 
 
• **Encaurage** (प्रोत्साहित): This is an incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is **"Encourage".**
 
 
• **Example: **Teachers should **encourage** students to participate in extracurricular activities.
 
 
 
• **Touresm** (पर्यटन): This is an incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is **"Tourism"**.
 
 
• **Example:** **Tourism** is a major industry in many countries around the world.
